nodes.description: Private constant 86400 used as time unit divisor for day based calculations.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable address that receives released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp of the token release period.
End timestamp of the release period, mutable in terminate().
Total benefit amount available to the beneficiary, rewritten on terminate().
Accounting of the amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag marking that the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Owner address inherited from Ownable, controls terminate().
SupervisedTimelock constructor: sets token, beneficiary, release window and validates end time against block.timestamp.
View accessor returning the held IERC20 token.
View accessor returning the beneficiary address.
View accessor returning the total benefit amount.
Computes the currently released amount using block.timestamp, start and end times.
View returning totalBenefit minus releasedBalance.
View accessor returning the withdrawn balance.
Public withdraw that computes the releasable delta, updates accounting and transfers tokens to the beneficiary.
Owner-only termination that collapses the release window and sweeps the unreleased remainder to the owner.
Caller identity used for ownership checks in Ownable/onlyOwner.
Miner-controllable time used to compute released balance, constructor validation and termination window.
External token().safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) call inside withdraw(), which transfers control to an arbitrary token contract.
External token().safeTransfer(owner(), amountToWithdraw) call inside terminate(), which transfers control to an arbitrary token contract.
Constructor parameter holding the IERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter holding the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the release start time, truncated to a day boundary.
Constructor parameter for the number of days of the lock period.
Constructor parameter for the total benefit amount.
Local in withdraw(): releasedBalance() minus withdrawedBalance.
Local in terminate(): token balance minus the remaining benefit.
Local in releasedBalance(): elapsed days since release start.
Local in releasedBalance(): total days in the release window.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token parameter into the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor assigns beneficiary_ into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor writes the day-truncated start time into _releaseStartTime.
Constructor computes _releaseEndTime from start time plus lock days.
Constructor stores totalBenefit_ into _totalBenefit.
Constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero.
Constructor initializes the _isTerminated flag to false.
Constructor validation require(_releaseEndTime > block.timestamp) depends on miner-controllable time.
Constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender(), i.e. msg.sender.
releasedBalance() branches and divides based on the current block.timestamp.
terminate() sets _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp, so the sweep amount is time dependent.
terminate() is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
releasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit to compute the pro-rata amount.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseStartTime for the elapsed-days computation.
releasedBalance() reads _releaseEndTime to clamp the released amount.
withdraw() calls releasedBalance() to determine the currently releasable amount.
The value returned by releasedBalance() flows into the withdraw accounting and transfer.
withdraw() increases _withdrawedBalance by the computed amount.
withdraw() performs the external token transfer, handing control to the token contract.
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient of the safeTransfer in withdraw().
withdraw() reads _token via token() to perform the balance check and transfer.
terminate() calls releasedBalance() to freeze the accrued benefit.
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the released balance.
terminate() rewrites _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp truncated to a day.
terminate() sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate() performs an external token transfer to the owner, transferring control outside the contract.
owner() reads _owner and its address is the recipient of the sweep transfer in terminate().
A malicious token contract can re-enter withdraw() during safeTransfer before the external call fully settles.
A malicious token contract can re-enter terminate() during the owner sweep transfer.
Constructor parameter token_ is assigned into _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned into _beneficiary.
Day-truncated releaseStartTime_ is assigned into _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ is used to compute _releaseEndTime.
daysOfTimelock_ multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY determines _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned into _totalBenefit.
Local amount is added into _withdrawedBalance inside withdraw().
Local amount is the value transferred in the withdraw() safeTransfer.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value transferred in the terminate() safeTransfer.
Local passedDays feeds the pro-rata released amount computation.
Local totalDays is the denominator of the pro-rata released amount computation.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to truncate the start time and to compute the lock duration.
releasedBalance() divides elapsed seconds by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to obtain passed and total days.
terminate() uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to truncate block.timestamp to a day boundary.
token() view returns _token.
beneficiary() view returns _beneficiary.
totalBenefit() view returns _totalBenefit.
unreleasedBalance() calls releasedBalance().
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
withdrawedBalance() view returns _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw() calls token() to reach the IERC20 balance check and transfer.
terminate() reads owner() (which reads _owner) for the sweep recipient and event.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ only feeds the immutable _token assignment in constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ only feeds the immutable _beneficiary assignment in constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is truncated and stored into _releaseStartTime/_releaseEndTime inside constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ only sizes the release window in constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ only initializes _totalBenefit in constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
Local amount is the value carried by the external token transfer in withdraw(); merge it into the withdraw safeTransfer unsafe operation.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value carried by the external token transfer in terminate(); merge it into the terminate safeTransfer unsafe operation.
Local passedDays is an intermediate of the releasedBalance() time computation; merge it into the releasedBalance function node.
Local totalDays is an intermediate of the releasedBalance() time computation; merge it into the releasedBalance function node.
